description: This file defines the EmployeeDirectoryService class, which provides a service layer for employee directory operations in the OrangeHRM system. It includes a method to retrieve an EmployeeDirectoryDao instance, with lazy initialization.

classes.name: EmployeeDirectoryService
classes.description: A service class responsible for managing employee directory data interactions within the OrangeHRM Corporate Directory plugin.

methods.name: getEmployeeDirectoryDao
methods.description: Returns an instance of EmployeeDirectoryDao, instantiating it if it does not already exist.
